name: Tumblr

sources.title: Tumblr registration page — email signup or Google/Apple OAuth

requirements: A Tumblr account (email or Google/Apple sign-in)
Content must follow Tumblr's community policy
preparation: A post introducing the product with the product URL
workflow: Open tumblr.com/register and sign up (email, Google, or Apple)
Customize the blog appearance minimally (avatar, title, description with product link)
Publish a post announcing/linking to the product, tagged appropriately
Verify the blog renders publicly while logged out
watchFor: Tumblr is a social blogging community, not a directory — reach depends on tags/reblogs, not listing pages
New accounts posting nothing but outbound product links read as spam; a real post with context performs better
The register page rendered only the OAuth buttons in fetched HTML — email-signup field behavior not verified
countsAsLive: The blog is publicly reachable at <name>.tumblr.com and the product post is visible to logged-out visitors
unknowns: Whether outbound post links are dofollow
Any new-account restrictions (rate limits, link filters) not visible on the registration page
